title: 尘埃
desc: 只吃 Canvas 2D 与指针事件，任何能开网页的设备都跑得动。
descEn: Canvas 2D and pointer events only. Runs anywhere the page opens.

title: 沙粒模拟
desc: 质量块用 wasm 的 v128 并行算，SIMD 字节码被拒就只能回退标量路径。
descEn: The mass solver runs on wasm v128. If the SIMD bytecode is rejected, only the scalar path remains.

title: 织线
desc: 多线程求解器，要 SharedArrayBuffer。GitHub Pages 设不了 COOP/COEP，在这类托管上永远是「站点限制」，不是访客的机器不行。
descEn: A multithreaded solver needing SharedArrayBuffer. GitHub Pages cannot send COOP/COEP, so here it always reads as a hosting limit, not a device failure.

title: 路径
desc: WebGPU compute，要 subgroups 特性与 8192 的纹理维度。内核没有 navigator.gpu 判 x，有 API 但拒给适配器判灰。
descEn: WebGPU compute needing the subgroups feature and an 8192 texture dimension. No navigator.gpu is an x; an API that refuses an adapter stays grey.

title: 折减
desc: 要 WebGPU 的 subgroups-reduce。这条在 2026 年的 Chromium 上还没有，判 x；换成支持的构建或内核就自动转绿——这类差异只有现场测才看得出来。
descEn: Needs the WebGPU subgroups-reduce feature, absent from this Chromium line, so it shows an x. A build that has it turns green on its own — exactly the kind of difference only a live probe can see.
